name: Scheduler
author: MouseGestures
description: Run gesture actions on a schedule instead of a gesture. Comes with a few ready-made schedules (top of the hour, midnight, noon, sunrise, sunset, weekday mornings…), and you can build your own or set a custom one right in the gesture: specific dates, days of the week, every N days or weeks, monthly (a day, the last day, the 2nd Tuesday), yearly, every N minutes, or sunrise and sunset. Then pick them as a Plugin trigger.
